paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 4.52 as of September 25, 2026, with a decrease of 0.66% from the prior close and 19.43% over 22 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Fermi Inc. has been in the news recently due to a report that OpenAI may be exploring a 10-gigawatt data center lease in Ohio, which could potentially benefit the company, according to Citizens analysts. This news caused FRMI stock to surge nearly 27% on September 26, 2026, as reported by Stocktwits.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a total of 25 filings, with 3 of them being Form 4 filings. Recent filings include a Form PX14A6G on September 11, 2026, and a Form 8-K on August 31, 2026, which announced the scheduling of the company's first annual meeting of stockholders. Insider transactions have also been reported, with two Form 4 filings on August 27 and August 18, 2026.
